description: This file defines the LoadedProperty class which implements the PropertyReflection interface from PHPStan. It represents a loaded property with metadata such as its declaring class, type, visibility, and mutability, providing methods to access and inquire about these properties.

classes.name: LoadedProperty
classes.description: A class implementing PropertyReflection, representing a loaded property with specific characteristics such as type, declaring class, and visibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LoadedProperty with its declaring class, type, and writability.

methods.name: getDeclaringClass
methods.description: Returns the class reflection of the class that declares this property.

methods.name: isStatic
methods.description: Indicates whether this property is static (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: isPrivate
methods.description: Indicates whether this property is private (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Indicates whether this property is public (always true in this implementation).

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates whether this property is readable (always true).

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether this property is writable.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Returns null as there is no doc comment associated with this property.

methods.name: getReadableType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property when read.

methods.name: getWritableType
methods.description: Returns a NeverType instance, indicating the property is not writable.

methods.name: canChangeTypeAfterAssignment
methods.description: Indicates whether the property type can change after assignment (always false).

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic instance indicating the property is not deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatedDescription
methods.description: Returns null as no deprecated description is provided.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Returns a TrinaryLogic instance indicating the property is not internal.
